senales.title: Signals
senales.intro: Walpulse generates on-chain reputation, maturity, and risk signals for wallets (A–F scale). Signals are verifiable and explainable: the recipient can audit how each grade was reached.

senales.gradesBody: A–F scale. Each grade comes with a breakdown (explainability). The goal is for the recipient to understand why that grade was assigned—not just receive an opaque score.
senales.roadmapNote: Web v1 focuses on current signals. Any roadmap mention is brief and without date promises.

paraPsav.title: For VASPs
paraPsav.message: We deliver verifiable, explainable on-chain signals on source of funds, recent behavior, and wallet maturity so VASPs can strengthen risk assessment and monitoring within their own due-diligence framework.
paraPsav.problemBody: BCU Circular No. 2507 establishes the authorization regime and obligations for Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs / PSAVs) in Uruguay. VASPs need stronger wallet risk assessment and monitoring. Part of that intelligence can come from verifiable on-chain signals.
paraPsav.problemClose: Walpulse addresses that need from the on-chain signals side, without assuming the formal obligations the regulation assigns to the VASP.

map.contribution: Good as signals (wash, circular, bot-like, mixing)

does: Produces on-chain reputation, maturity, and risk signals for wallets (A–F scale).
Delivers verifiable, explainable information (the recipient can audit how each grade was reached).
Especially covers: source of funds, recent behavior, multi-chain presence, and portfolio quality.
Serves as input so the VASP can enrich its own risk assessment and monitoring system.
doesNot: It does not perform KYC or identify the person behind the wallet.
It does not execute Travel Rule.
It does not report to UIAF.
It does not perform official list screening or freezing.
It does not make compliance decisions or classify customers into regulatory risk categories.
It does not produce the formal report or written examination the regulation requires from the VASP.
benefits: Structured on-chain evidence on source of funds and recent behavior.
Early detection of risk signals (mixing, wash trading, bot-like activity, anomalous concentrations).
Enrichment of the activity profile and risk-based approach with auditable data.
Traceability: Walpulse does not obfuscate; it classifies and makes behavior more visible.
Integration as input to the VASP’s own due-diligence process, without transferring regulatory responsibility.

nosotros.title: About
nosotros.intro: Walpulse grows out of concrete work in the Ethereum Uruguay ecosystem. What began as ORIGO at a hackathon became production signals and later an independent project delivering on-chain reputation intelligence for wallets.
nosotros.originBody: At the Ethereum Uruguay Hackathon 2026 (3rd edition), the ORIGO project — verifiable analysis of wallet source of funds — won 1st place in the Startup category. The final pitch and awards ceremony took place at Blockchain Summit Global 2026 (Montevideo).
nosotros.originBody2: It did not stay a demo: source-of-funds signals were integrated into production as Walcert Origins. Walpulse is the independent project that continues and expands that approach.
nosotros.originTeam: Hackathon team (public coverage): Jair Valenzuela and Rodrigo Médica.
nosotros.founderBio: Data Engineer with over 12 years of experience in databases, data warehousing, and large-scale data transformation. He leads Walpulse product vision and the definition of on-chain reputation signals.
nosotros.projectsIntro: Walpulse is part of a line of work on on-chain reputation signals.

comoFunciona.explainClose: That matters when signals are used as input for risk analysis, due diligence, or investigation.
comoFunciona.b2bBody: Walpulse is designed as an on-chain intelligence source for teams that monitor wallets, assess risk, run due diligence, or investigate. Today the value is in the signals themselves: lookup by wallet and interpretation by the recipient. The next layer is integrating that intelligence into their own processes.
